nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Rescue Barrier Balm with 1% Dimethicone

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination skin that is flaky on the nose and chin describes it as balancing oiliness and dryness together, but no reviewer with purely oily skin is represented.
segments.dry: The largest group of reviewers describe dry, very dry, or extremely dry skin and report the balm relieves flaking, tightness, and winter dryness, often citing visible dry patches gone within days.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it helps hydrate dry areas over winter without noting new breakouts, though one calls the texture heavy and says daily use isn't needed.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report calming, non-irritating results including with eczema, rosacea, and dermatitis, but a couple report burning or no improvement despite not considering themselves sensitive.
segments.mature: A small number of reviewers in their late 40s describe it as the best moisturizer they've tried, with one crediting it for smoother, younger-looking skin.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports smoother texture and a more youthful look after consistent use; this is not corroborated by other reviewers focused on aging specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe resolving dry patches, flaking, and tightness within days, especially in winter, with skin described as hydrated, soft, and plump; effects are widely consistent across this group.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, dermatitis, and eczema-related redness report it calms and reduces redness, including around the nose and eye area; no dissent noted for this concern specifically.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers recovering from over-exfoliation, retinoid use, or a damaged barrier report fast repair overnight to within a few days; one reviewer, however, reports burning and increased dryness despite no barrier damage.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including those calling their skin acne-prone, but one reviewer reports the product caused painful cystic acne.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily-and-dry combination skin reports the product balanced oiliness without clogging pores; no other reviewer discusses oiliness directly.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture that absorbs well
Tube coloring rubs off, feels cheap
High price relative to similar products

extraits.texte: i do not have sensitive skin at all and this still burns when i put it on even if my skin barrier is not damaged. it also is not moisturizing at all in fact i think it made my skin drier. after using it my skin became flaky with dry patches. ive never had a reaction like this before i just cannot reccomend there are better products

This wasn't as "bamly" as i had hoped. Its more like a thick moisturizer. That aside, this sady gave me painful cystic acne. I use all First Aid Beauty in my routine but once i added this here came the acne. It isn't scented, was easy to apply but for the price its just a thick moisturizer imo.

extraits.titre: Good with no cons, but pricey for what it is
extraits.texte: As someone with very dry sensitive skin and eczema as well, this lotion works well for me. It's rich but not greasy and never broke me out or caused irritation. That being said…there are other lotions and balms very similar to this that are $20 cheaper. I probably won't rebuy for that reason, but I have no real cons. I will say that the coloring is starting to rub off of the tube — it looks nice but i think maybe the packaging is a little cheap and they just wanted the aesthetics of the crinkle tube over plastic.

extraits.titre: Solved my flaky oily dry skin issue
extraits.texte: This is a surprise hit for me! My skin is sensitive, itchy, prone to breakouts, and dry yet oily (flaky on nose and chin). This has solved all of that! I've only been using it 2x a day for a week and wow 😲 ! No more redness. My skin feels soft, smooth, and balanced - no more dry and flaky and oily at the same time. A little goes a long way so the big tube will last a while. I usually break out a few days after trying a new product, but not this time. Love it!

extraits.titre: What I use for my eczema
extraits.texte: I was skeptical abour using this product when I bought it because I've tried a lot of creams/ointments to help treat my ezcema. I refuse to use steroid creams/ointments again because of the withdrawl it had on my skin. This product is my holy grail. I have severe ezcema on the toos of my hands, elbows and tops of my feet. My skin gets triggered by weather changes, heat, and sometimes food. This cream/balm keeps my skin from having crazy flare ups, and very much reduces the texture and look of my ezcema. I will continue to purchase this balm when I run out of my current one!

This helped my skin rebalance, clear up and feel so hydrated! My skin was acne prone and super sensitive, this cream saved it! My only discord is the packaging but it's such a great product that I'll overlook but just hope they change it eventually!

I have cpap dermatitis, Ive been using a cpap mask on my face whether full face or just nasal mask Ive broken out bad in the past. Ive used liners and eczema creams and this is the one thats helping my skin look and feel more even and not dry, crepey and red where the mask sat. Ive been using this most mornings for the past week or 2 and my face recovers from the cpap mask so fast. I wipe with micellar wipes, air dry, use a hydrating pillow pad, air dry again, then use this, air dry again, then apply my mineral sunscreen that contains naiacinimide. Im going to subscribe.
